name: TcrToken/Tecra pool unauthorised USDT drain
summary: TcrToken.burnFrom checked and reduced _allowances[msg.sender][from] instead of _allowances[from][msg.sender]. A caller could therefore approve the pool as a spender of the caller's balance, burn TCR directly from the pool without the pool's authorization, synchronize the depleted TCR reserve, and exchange previously acquired TCR for the pool's USDT.
notes: Direct TcrToken deployment; the runtime is unchanged through the exploit, and its optional legacy-upgrade route was off (deprecated false, upgradedAddress zero), so burnFrom ran in this code.

Loss is the TCR/USDT pair's net USDT depletion in the anchor (639,109.390004, the attacker's 112.86 USDT input netted) plus copycat 0x47acdd86's burnFrom drain of 259.293347 USDT in Aug 2022, at DefiLlama USDT prices; burned TCR is not counted separately.
